camel_example: aliyun eas GET /api/v2/benchmark-tasks --region cn-hangzhou --Order desc --Status Creating --PageSize 10 --Filter test_bench --ServiceName test_bench_srv --PageNumber 1 --RequestMethod 'example-string' --Sort CreateTime --ModelId 'example-string' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
description_en: Queries all stress testing tasks deployed by the current user
description_zh: 查看当前用户部署的所有压测任务
kebab_example: aliyun eas list-benchmark-task --filter test_bench --sort CreateTime --order desc --service-name test_bench_srv --status Creating --model-id example-string --request-method example-string --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListBenchmarkTask

parameters.help_en: The filter parameter. If specified, the system searches for records that match the specified value in the EAS service name and stress testing task name
parameters.help_zh: 过滤参数。如果指定，将分别查找EAS服务名和压测任务名中和指定参数匹配的记录
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:
desc: Descending order. This is the default value.
asc: Ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式，取值如下：
desc（默认值）：降序。
asc：升序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The name of the EAS service that corresponds to the stress testing task. For more information about how to query the service name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.help_zh: 压测任务对应的EAS服务名称。如何查询服务名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.name: service_name

parameters.help_en: The execution status used to filter stress testing tasks
parameters.help_zh: 筛选压测任务的执行状态
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The request method for stress testing. Valid values:
concurrency: Fixed concurrency mode.
requestRate: Fixed request rate mode.
peakThroughput: Peak throughput mode
parameters.help_zh: 压测请求方式。支持：固定并发模式（concurrency）、固定请求速率模式（requestRate）、极限吞吐模式（peakThroughput）三种
parameters.name: request_method

parameters.help_en: The page number of the stress testing task list. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 压测任务列表的页码。起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of stress testing tasks to return on each page. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页显示的压测任务数量，默认为100
parameters.name: page_size

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned stress testing task list
PageNumber.description_zh: 返回查询的压测任务列表的页码

PageSize.description_en: The number of stress testing tasks returned on each page
PageSize.description_zh: 返回每页显示的压测任务数量

AvailableAgent.description_en: The number of available stress testing instances

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the stress testing task was created. The time is in UTC and follows the RFC3339 format
CreateTime.description_zh: 压测任务的创建时间。UTC 时间，RFC3339 格式

Message.description_en: The summary information of the service

Region.description_en: The region where the stress testing task is located

ServiceName.description_en: The name of the service to be stress tested

Status.description_en: The status of the stress testing task

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the stress testing task

TaskName.description_en: The name of the stress testing task

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the stress testing task was updated. The time is in UTC and follows the RFC3339 format
UpdateTime.description_zh: 压测任务的更新时间。UTC 时间，RFC3339 格式

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of tasks queried
